author: KEXP
description:
Asheville, NC outfit Wednesday offer an intoxicating collection of narrative-heavy Southern rock on their latest record 'Bleeds.' Beautifully balancing poetry and noise, the band share a performance of "Elderberry Wine" and more. 

Watch the full in-studio session on our Live on KEXP YouTube channel.
title: Wednesday - Live on KEXP
